_comment: ECU deployment target descriptor for the DMS-1 driver-monitoring / forward-collision function. Describes the physical target the aarch64 firmware installs to and the phased OTA rollout plan the Uptane Director follows.

ecu.asil: ASIL-B (function contributes to ASIL-D FCW arbitration)

preconditions: vehicle parked / ignition-off (no update while driving)
rollout.rollback: A/B partition; Director reverts to previous signed target on DTC or failed self-test
